answer: Each identity must carry a relic earned by a slow comet trail: a chain of sixty small verified tasks, one step per epoch, that cannot be parallelized or bought, because each step is seeded by the previous epoch's public randomness. A jade seal is stamped only after the full trail, so a farm wanting a thousand voting identities must run a thousand trails for sixty epochs, paying a small fee at every step, while one honest agent walks a single trail in the background. Any identity caught sharing steps or reusing another's trail loses its relic and every fee it paid.
